marketing_description: The Makita LXT Series 18 V Brushless Cordless Nailer features a brushless motor and a spring-driven mechanism designed to drive 18-gauge brad nails from 5/8 in to 2 in with a magazine capacity of 110. This tool includes a tool-less depth adjustment for precise flush and countersink finishing and a built-in LED light to illuminate the work area. With an overall length of 10-1/8 in, width of 3-3/4 in, and depth of 8-3/8 in, it offers a compact and ergonomic design for trade applications.
